影子为什么变长变短？: Why do shadows grow and shrink?
移动小灯，看看小木偶的影子躲到了哪一边。: Move the lamp and watch which way the wooden puppet’s shadow points.

灯在左边，影子伸向右边。: Lamp on the left; shadow to the right.
灯在右边，影子伸向左边。: Lamp on the right; shadow to the left.

木偶挡住了一部分光，地面上收到这盏灯的光较少，那片较暗的地方就是影子。: The puppet blocks some of the light. The ground behind it receives less light from this lamp, creating a shadow.
灯和木偶的左右距离不变时，灯越高，影子越短。灯换到左边，影子就伸向右边；灯换到右: At the same sideways distance, a higher lamp makes a shorter shadow. A lamp on the left makes a shadow to the right, and a lamp on the right makes one to the left.
保持灯在同一边，把灯举高。影子会变长，还是变短？再把灯移到另一边。: Keep the lamp on one side and raise it. Will the shadow grow or shrink? Then move the lamp to the other side.
这里用点光源与水平地面。设灯高为 H，木偶高为 h，水平间距为 d，相似三角形给: This model uses a point light and level ground. With lamp height H, puppet height h and horizontal separation d, similar triangles give shadow length L = dh/(H−h), with H > h. Directly overhead, the vertical centerline has zero shadow length; the puppet’s width still casts a shadow beneath it. The distant Sun is better approximated by parallel rays; its shadow length depends on solar elevation.
画面只精确计算木偶最高点到地面的光线与中心影长。木偶和影子的宽度经过艺术简化，不: The ray from the puppet’s highest point and the centerline shadow length are calculated. Puppet and shadow width are stylized; penumbra, multiple lights and reflections are omitted. Units are illustrative. An adult can repeat this with a flashlight and block; never look directly at strong lights or the Sun.

木偶由简化的三维木块组成，投影沿直线落到平地。中心线公式只描述头顶正中这一条光线: The figure consists of simplified 3D wooden shapes projected along straight rays onto a flat plane. The centerline formula follows the top-center ray, not the maximum extent of the whole shadow. Nine source samples approximate an extended lamp and its softer edge. Reflections and calibrated brightness are omitted; divisions are illustrative.
